# GSAP — vendored dependency

`gsap.min.js` in this directory is GSAP 3.14.2 (https://gsap.com), vendored
locally so HyperFrames scene renders don't depend on a live CDN fetch.

Used under GSAP's Standard "No Charge" license: https://gsap.com/standard-license.
See that page for full terms (in short: free to use, including commercially,
in end products — not for reselling or sublicensing GSAP itself as a
standalone library).
